tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Night is a warm black; Paper is the cream poster stock.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus and popovers that sit on the ground.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: input fields, meter tracks, code.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk. Also the heavy structural rules, card frames and the ink block in compositions.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and inactive tabs, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk (at least 5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers that carry no meaning: tab baselines, card footers, outlined tags. Never the only border on a control.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The square. Primary action, the active-tab bar, danger. As text it reads on surface and surface-raised (5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a red fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: The triangle. Warnings, highlights, the focus ring at Night. A fill only: never yellow text.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a yellow fill.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The circle. Information, progress, the switch's on state, the focus ring on Paper. As text it reads on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a blue fill.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for compositions, illustrations and chart series. Not for text or UI state.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for compositions and chart series. Not for text or UI state.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for compositions and chart series, used sparingly as one block per composition. Not for text or UI state.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Always paired with the square glyph and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution states. Always paired with the triangle glyph and a word.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information and success. Always paired with the circle glyph and a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px outline offset 3px. Yellow at Night, blue on Paper; at least 6:1 on every surface in its theme.

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: One per view, at most. Cover lines and empty-state headlines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Three shapes and three colours carry every meaning in this system.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, tags and field labels. Always uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, metadata and timestamps, in ink-muted.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Codes, values in meters and tables. Tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-text gaps inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The base unit. Gaps inside controls, tag padding, label-to-field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input side padding, tab vertical padding, stripe pitch.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between sibling controls; small button padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, button side padding, gap between tabs.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections within a page.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margins at desktop width; between major regions.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every rectangle: buttons, cards, fields, tags. The system has no rounded rectangles.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: True circles only: the switch knob when on, status discs, avatars.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Reserved for half-round ends in compositions. Not for controls.

stroke.note: Line weights. Rules are structure, not decoration.

tokens.name: stroke-1
tokens.usage: Hairlines in the line colour.

tokens.name: stroke-2
tokens.usage: Control borders, card frames, the focus outline.

tokens.name: stroke-4
tokens.usage: Active indicators and composition rules.

tokens.name: stroke-8
tokens.usage: Poster rules in large compositions.

shadow.note: Flat by default. The one shadow is a hard offset, like a misregistered print.

tokens.name: shadow-block
tokens.usage: Hover on primary and secondary buttons, and open menus. Never blurred, never on more than one element at a time.
